notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR page is the only tower-specific source; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list confirms the county and standing status. The NHLR gives the build date only as late 1930s, so no build year was entered as an event. Height is converted from the NHLR's 100 feet (30.5 m). Do not confuse this with the Millston entry on the Forest Fire Lookout Association list, which is marked gone at a different location (44.16192, -90.65797). Agency is inferred from the statewide DNR decommissioning statements. Access, ownership and rental are not in any source read. No photos added. Not verified: current condition, sale status, or any move since the 2018 registration.
